propositions: Ticket directory creation races: mkdir happens outside write lock, first event file lands after lock acquisition, leaving empty dirs if writer dies in between
Debris signature: fsck reports MISSING_CREATE (no event found) and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH (dir exists, no file) for empty stray ticket directories left by interrupted writes

Fix: stage directory and first event together in dot-prefixed temp path, publish atomically with single os.rename under existing write lock, making temp paths invisible to fsck scanners via convention
Batch and reconciler paths inherit same vulnerability via shared _prepare_event call; both converted to use StagedEvent.promote and new _rollback_batch cleanup

Stale temp path sweep: bounded best-effort removal of .tmp-newticket-* dirs owned by dead pids, using write-lock v2 stamp (host+pid-namespace+start-time) to defeat pid recycling; never touches ticket dirs or event data per 043f boundary
